questions.q: What did Sara whisper to her father?
choices: Is this the place we're at?
questions.explain: This is the only place Sara whispers this during the voyage.

questions.q: What did Sara often try to make some young officers' wives do?
choices: Talk to her about grown-up things
Play with the Lascars on the deck
questions.explain: Sara often talked to young officers' wives about the world they belonged to.

questions.q: What did Sara think was a puzzling thing about their journey?
choices: The hot deck on the ship
The differences in the weather and places they visited
questions.explain: Sara found it confusing to go from India to sea to a new place.

questions.q: What did Sara whisper to her father at the end of the voyage?
questions.explain: Sara was unsure if they had reached their destination.

questions.q: How did Sara feel about the journey from Bombay to the new place?
questions.explain: Sara found the journey from Bombay to the new place puzzling.

questions.q: What did Sara dream about during the voyage?
questions.explain: Sara dreamed about the new place they were about to reach.
